text: One day a stranger saw Smiley. <break time="0.8s" /> With the box and asked. <break time="0.8s" /> What might it be that you have in the box. <break time="0.8s" /> It might be a parrot or a canary. <break time="0.8s" /> But it is only a frog. <break time="0.8s" /> Smiley answered carelessly. <break time="0.8s" /> The stranger took the box. <break time="0.8s" /> Turned it this way and that and looked at the frog carefully. <break time="0.8s" /> What is he good for he asked. <break time="0.8s" /> And Smiley said that he could outjump any frog. <break time="0.8s" /> In the county. <break time="0.8s" /> After a long look. <break time="0.8s" /> The stranger said. <break time="0.8s" /> I do not see any points. <break time="0.8s" /> About that frog. <break time="0.8s" /> That make him any better. <break time="0.8s" /> Than any other frog. <break time="0.8s" /> Maybe you do not Smiley said. <break time="0.8s" /> But I will bet forty dollars. <break time="0.8s" /> That he can outjump any frog. <break time="0.8s" /> In Calaveras County. <break time="0.8s" /> The stranger said sadly. <break time="0.8s" /> I am only a stranger here. <break time="0.8s" /> And I do not have a frog. <break time="0.8s" /> But if I had a frog. <break time="0.8s" /> I would bet you. <break time="0.8s" /> That is all right. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Smiley. <break time="0.8s" /> If you hold my box a minute. <break time="0.8s" /> I will go and get you a frog. <break time="0.8s" /> So the stranger put up his forty dollars. <break time="0.8s" /> And sat down to wait. <break time="0.8s" /> While Smiley went to the swamp. <break time="0.8s" /> Left alone. <break time="0.8s" /> The stranger took out Daniel Webster. <break time="0.8s" /> Opened his mouth. <break time="0.8s" /> And filled him with quail shot. <break time="0.8s" /> Almost up to his chin.
